set -euo pipefail; BUILD=build/idf-stage28e-c-memory-audit-v1; ELF="$BUILD/growbox_ml_controller.elf"; MAP="$BUILD/growbox_ml_controller.map"; TOOL=$(find /Users/michal/.espressif/tools/xtensa-esp-elf -type f -name xtensa-esp32s3-elf-nm 2>/dev/null | head -1); test -x "$TOOL"; python3 - <<'PY'
import re, subprocess, pathlib, os
b=pathlib.Path('build/idf-stage28e-c-memory-audit-v1')
elf=b/'growbox_ml_controller.elf'
# Use toolchain nm from PATH after IDF build if available, otherwise locate it.
import shutil
nm=shutil.which('xtensa-esp32s3-elf-nm')
if not nm:
    hits=list(pathlib.Path('/Users/michal/.espressif/tools').rglob('xtensa-esp32s3-elf-nm'))
    nm=str(hits[0]) if hits else None
if not nm: raise SystemExit('xtensa-esp32s3-elf-nm not found')
out=subprocess.check_output([nm,'-S','--size-sort','--radix=d',str(elf)],text=True,errors='replace')
rows=[]
for line in out.splitlines():
    p=line.split(None,4)
    if len(p)<4: continue
    try: size=int(p[1])
    except: continue
    typ=p[2]; name=p[3] if len(p)==4 else p[4]
    if typ in 'BbDdSsGgCc': rows.append((size,typ,name))
print('STAGE28E_C_TOP_STATIC_SYMBOLS_BEGIN')
for size,typ,name in sorted(rows,reverse=True)[:60]: print(f'{size:8d} {typ} {name}')
print('STAGE28E_C_TOP_STATIC_SYMBOLS_END')
# ELF sections via objdump/readelf if available.
readelf=shutil.which('xtensa-esp32s3-elf-readelf')
if not readelf:
    hits=list(pathlib.Path('/Users/michal/.espressif/tools').rglob('xtensa-esp32s3-elf-readelf'))
    readelf=str(hits[0]) if hits else None
if readelf:
    sec=subprocess.check_output([readelf,'-S','--wide',str(elf)],text=True,errors='replace')
    wanted=[]
    for line in sec.splitlines():
        if any(x in line for x in [' .data ',' .bss ',' .iram0.text ',' .dram0.data ',' .dram0.bss ',' .flash.text ',' .flash.rodata ',' .rtc']): wanted.append(line.strip())
    print('STAGE28E_C_SECTION_ROWS_BEGIN'); print('\n'.join(wanted)); print('STAGE28E_C_SECTION_ROWS_END')
PY
